_comment: Public repositories deliberately left off the profile, read by scripts/profile_coverage.py. The nightly curation run adds an entry for every repo it decides not to list. An entry with a 'revisit' date (YYYY-MM-DD) comes back for review on that date.

homebrew-tap.reason: Homebrew tap for packaged tools, not a project.

homebrew-sbh.reason: Homebrew tap for Storage Ballast Helper, not a project.

scoop-bucket.reason: Scoop bucket for packaged tools, not a project.

franken_nlp.reason: Re-checked Oct 30, 2026: its README says no kernel exists yet and the production feature graph is not wired, and nothing shows the engine has compiled or run the model.

franken_remote.reason: Re-checked Oct 30, 2026: live two-machine sessions now carry video, input, clipboard, files and audio, but only between Linux X11 Xvfb displays for one viewer, and its README says it is not an installable remote desktop yet.

franken_threed.reason: Re-checked Oct 30, 2026: its README still says no speedup has been measured and pixel parity holds for 10 scenes on software Vulkan only, so the headline claims are targets, not results.

franken_native_capsule.reason: Internal native-code capsule for FrankenEngine (ADR-0010), not a standalone project.

franken_mining.reason: A day old: its README says status is design plan and scaffold in progress, nothing runs end to end yet, and every capability is DESIGN or TARGET until its first milestone (M0, planned Nov 2026 to Jan 2027) passes its gate.

beads_for_cass.reason: Static Beads issue dashboard for CASS, like the other generated dashboards.

toon-go.reason: Thin Go wrapper around toon_rust, which the profile already lists as TOON Rust.

guide_to_openai_response_api_and_agents_.reason: Obsolete guide to a since-revised OpenAI API.

gemini-api-updater-doc.reason: Obsolete reference document for an older Gemini API.

ChatTTS.reason: Copy of 2noise/ChatTTS repackaged for pip, not original work.
